saying that that the iphone pro max outsells other models because it has better dbrand accessories sales is a confounding bias, it may just mean that people that buy the pro max are more likely to buy dbrand accessories because a third unknown variable , for example they are willing to spend more on their phones accessories from a reputable brand like dbrand, or that they might be better informed about more niche accessories options that dbrand offers than the buyers of other models , you can't make a causal association on phones sale numbers from that observation alone, 

for example if dbrand offers battery packs for all iphone models and the iphone airs battery pack outsells others it would not mean that iphone air is apple's best selling model, it means that the iphone air user is more likely to buy a battery pack (because if the smaller overall battery life of the iphone air) 

with all that being said the iphone pro max is the best seller XD
